summary: Frontend-only smoke of 5 focused flows for Iter 36 (leave calendars desktop+mobile, training progress UI, public payslip verify, regression). All 5 flows PASS. No frontend or backend issues observed.
critical_code_review_comments: TrainingProgressPanel calls /branches on every mount; consider memoizing / lifting to a shared context since /talent already fetches branch list.

MobileLeave TeamCalendar and LeaveCalendar both duplicate month-grid rendering logic (buildDayMap, firstDow, cells array). Fine now but if a 3rd calendar surface is added, extract a <MonthGrid> primitive.

verified_features.F1_desktop_leave_calendar: PASS — [data-testid=leave-calendar] rendered on /leave for admin@gov.sl. leave-calendar-next advanced August 2026→September 2026, leave-calendar-prev returned to August 2026. After POST /api/leave (Joseph Williams, 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12, annual, pending), day cells leave-calendar-day-2026-08-10/11/12 showed 'Joseph Williams' name chip (pending, gold).
verified_features.F2_mobile_leave_calendar: PASS — 390x844 /m/leave as admin: mobile-leave-calendar renders, day 2026-08-10 shows count badge, tapping mobile-leave-cal-day-2026-08-10 populates mobile-leave-cal-detail with 'Joseph Williams … annual · pending'. Logged in as sia.kallon@gov.sl (plain employee): mobile-leave-calendar is NOT rendered (backend 403 → hidden as expected).
verified_features.F3_training_progress_ui: PASS — After API POST /api/training-progress/complete {base_slug='getting-started', lang='en'} for sia, /m/training as sia shows mobile-training-my-progress='1/7 done' and mobile-training-done-getting-started badge visible. mobile-training-team is hidden for sia. Admin @ /m/training sees mobile-training-team with row mobile-training-team-row-<sia_eid> showing '1/7'. Desktop /talent → tab-learning → training-progress-panel table shows Sia Kallon row with 1/7 progress and tp-done-<sia_eid>-getting-started green check present.
verified_features.F4_public_payslip_verify: PASS — /verify-payslip/11735cd9-b568-42db-87a6-3e6d1aaec8b0 in a fresh (unauthenticated) context shows verify-payslip-valid with name='Aminata Kamara', period='2026-01', net='SLE 7,063.75'. /verify-payslip/bogus shows verify-payslip-invalid.
verified_features.F5_regression: PASS — admin /m/clock still shows mobile-clock-team-map (with in-zone/out-of-zone stats + loading map placeholder). Classic /login works for both admin@gov.sl and sia.kallon@gov.sl.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Payslip verification IDs live in mongo db.payslip_verifications; two exist for Aminata Kamara (2026-01 and 2027-02). Training video base slugs (EN) come from /api/marketing/videos?category=training&limit=60 filtered by lang=en (7 items) — 'getting-started' is the first sort-order slug. Leave calendar month keys are YYYY-MM zero-padded; day testids use the same YYYY-MM-DD format for both desktop (leave-calendar-day-*) and mobile (mobile-leave-cal-day-*). TrainingProgressPanel only renders when /training-progress/team returns 200 — hides silently on 403 (correct RBAC). For unauthenticated payslip verify, use a fresh browser context; the endpoint is /api/public/payslip/{id}.
